text:
maya: fyi sales requested a routing permit for Brightwave — they need guaranteed routing to `redwood-dedicated-eu` for compliance reasons. asking how we want to handle this as an "exception" vs policy change :thinking_face:
leo: can you paste the exact requirement? is this per-org header override, or we need their requests to always hit a specific pool/region?
chandra: Brightwave says traffic must run in eu-west and hit our dedicated capacity RG-42. they also want traffic pinned to model v2.1 (no fallback) during their onboarding window.
anya: ok that's a handful: region pin + dedicated pool + model pin. current routing policy supports per-org routing rules but we block persistent overrides that disable fallbacks. do we have a secure workflow for one-off enterprise exceptions?
maya: sales told me they want an "allowlist permit" for 90 days with SLA-backed latency targets. they expect us to add an override now and then extend if needed.
leo: technical constraints: we can support header-based routing (X-Org-ID or org header), token-based override (override-token header), or per-account ACL in the routing service. long-lived override tokens are dangerous.
anya: Product question: what should console UX look like for this? we need approval, TTL, reason, and audit log link. also a way to preview which routes will be affected.
chandra: sales prefers minimal friction. they can sign an SLA doc, but security will want approval flow + rotation every 30/90 days.
ops-bot: created ticket: PLAT-4567 — "Brightwave routing permit request" assigned to @leo and @anya. :white_check_mark:
leo: proposed internal API shape (draft):
```yaml
override:
  org_id: "brightwave"
  route_match:
    region: "eu-west"
    pool: "redwood-dedicated-eu-RG-42"
    model_version: "v2.1"
  constraints:
    fallback_allowed: false
    expiry: "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"
  approvals:
    - approver: "security"
    - approver: "platform"
  reason: "Compliance onboarding"
```
maya: that looks good. we should require `expiry` and at least one platform approver.
anya: UX: console should show a diff against default routing for that org and a one-click "preview" that simulates 10 sample requests. also show telemetry impact (cost/latency) before applying.
leo: implementation notes: router will honor per-org overrides if `override.active == true`. route-matching order: explicit override -> header override -> default policy. also need to ensure cache invalidation for routing decisions (TTL 30s).
chandra: audits: every override change must write to the audit-log service and emit telemetry: `override.created`, `override.updated`, `override.expired`, with org_id and actor. we also need a metric for %requests served by override vs default for SLO reporting.
anya: security: we need a manual approval gate for `fallback_allowed: false` since that prevents escalation to cheaper fallbacks during capacity problems. also require an owner contact and signed SLA doc uploaded.
leo: API example to create (internal only):
```http
POST /internal/v1/routing/overrides
Authorization: Bearer <plat-admin-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "org_id": "brightwave", "override": { ... } }
```
maya: who can approve? platform leads + security. we should make it configurable in the console per-override.
ops-bot: PLAT-4567 status changed: waiting-for-approval -> in-review (security requested more info).
chandra: ops notes: we should add a safety TTL and auto-revert. if override causes SLO breaches for other customers, we need an emergency rollback path (breakglass) that platform oncall can trigger.
leo: suggest adding a test harness: run the override in a `canary: true` mode for 1h where only 1% of traffic uses it and telemetry is collected. after pass -> promote to full.
anya: agree. console flow: request -> canary -> approve -> full -> auto-expire. show a changelog and allow manual extend with new approval.
maya: next steps: leo to prototype internal API + router handling, anya to design console screens and approval UX, security to define approvers + checklist. i'll coordinate with sales on timelines. :thumbsup:
chandra: please also add docs for support & SRE runbook: how to detect override-related incidents and how to roll back.
leo: will spike this week. estimate 3-4d for prototype + tests.
ops-bot: PLAT-4567 comment: security requested: "signed SLA upload + contact email".
maya: thanks everyone. ping me if blocked. :raised_hands:
